notes: οἱ … παραγενόμενοι ὑπηρέται analysed under rule 31: the article precedes the head noun it governs and takes the, and the participle recast as a finite relative clause keeps the supplied relativizer. This is the construction ACT.5.17 carries with ἡ οὖσα αἵρεσις, corrected there to match.
δέ takes the first and rather than leaving it to the participle-to-finite juncture; the second and is rule 88's on ἀπήγγειλαν.
